mapper.sql: id, code, name, customer, bu_id, owner_id, stage, version, created_by, created_at, updated_at, deadline, archived_from_stage, archived_at, archived_by, archive_reason, group_id, group_path, group_catalog_version, group_values
mapper.select: select from project where id = #{id} for update
select from project order by created_at desc
select from project where id in #{id}
select from project where bu_id = #{buId} order by created_at desc
mapper.sql:
where exists (select 1 from user_bu_role r join app_user u on u.id=r.user_id where r.user_id=#{userId} and r.bu_id=project.bu_id and r.status='ACTIVE' and u.status='ACTIVE' and not exists (select 1 from bu_member_profile bp where bp.user_id=r.user_id and bp.bu_id=r.bu_id and bp.enabled=false) and (r.role='BU_ADMIN' or (r.role in ('SR','TECH','APPROVER') and (project.owner_id=#{userId} or exists (select 1 from project_member m where m.project_id=project.id and m.user_id=#{userId} and m.enabled=true)))))
and stage='CANCELLED' and stage <> 'CANCELLED'
and (code like concat('%',#{f.keywordPattern},'%') escape '!' or name like concat('%',#{f.keywordPattern},'%') escape '!' or customer like concat('%',#{f.keywordPattern},'%') escape '!')
and stage=#{f.stage}
mapper.select: select from project order by ${q.orderBy}, id limit #{q.size} offset #{q.offset}
mapper.insert: insert into project (id, code, name, customer, bu_id, owner_id, stage, version, created_by, created_at, updated_at, deadline, archived_from_stage, archived_at, archived_by, archive_reason, group_id, group_path, group_catalog_version, group_values) values (#{id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{customer}, #{buId}, #{ownerId}, #{stage}, coalesce(#{version}, 0), #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{deadline}, #{archivedFromStage}, #{archivedAt}, #{archivedBy}, #{archiveReason}, #{groupId}, #{groupPath}, #{groupCatalogVersion}, #{groupValues})
mapper.sql: code = #{code}, name = #{name}, customer = #{customer}, bu_id = #{buId}, owner_id = #{ownerId}, stage = #{stage}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, deadline = #{deadline}, archived_from_stage = #{archivedFromStage}, archived_at = #{archivedAt}, archived_by = #{archivedBy}, archive_reason = #{archiveReason}
mapper.update: update project set where id = #{id} and version = #{version}
